title: Floating machine that stops river plastic before it reaches the sea
statement: Most ocean plastic comes from a small number of rivers. Design a floating machine anchored in a river that catches floating plastic waste, lifts it out of the water and stores it until it is collected, working on its own day and night.
constraints: Runs only on solar power, with no fuel and no grid connection
Removes up to 50,000 kg of floating waste per day
Boats and wildlife can still pass the river
